definitions: A fast and modern unit testing framework for JavaScript and TypeScript projects, built on top of Vite.
A testing tool known for its speed, HMR (Hot Module Replacement) support, and compatibility with Vite's plugin ecosystem.
examples: Many developers choose Vitest for its quick feedback loop.
Setting up Vitest in a new project is straightforward.
Vitest integrates seamlessly with Vite-powered applications.
